ops.en: THE SUMMONS [G72-13]. HEASFU ve-agida lakhem — 'GATHER, and I will tell you': the machine installs the testament's section — twelve addresses between a summons and a charge; be-ACHARIT ha-yamim — 'in the END of days': and the end is NOT told (the readings: the Presence withdrew and the end closed; the sons answer that the letters of SIN stand in none of their names, and the father answers that nei…

THE CHAPTER'S GOVERNING CLAIM, AND THE MACHINE'S REASON IT IS BLESSING AND NOT CHRONOLOGY [claim G72-24]. Three readings of what he meant to tell them, and the Rabbis' answer: he came to reveal the End and IT WAS CONCEALED FROM HIM - proven by the fact that his next word is a son's name. Only two are said to have had the End revealed and withdrawn. The gathering is opened four ways, closing on a c…

THE HEARING. hiqavtzu ve-SHIMU... ve-SHIMU — the hear-verb doubled around the two names (sons of JACOB; hear to ISRAEL): both names of the one man convene the twelve; the Kitzur hears the Shema in the summons (the six-word 'Hear, O Israel' spoken TO the father Israel, named [G72-13]); the midrash's tsere-reading of el ('as if toward the GOD of your father') named by MS: readings named, never merge…

THE STRONGEST LITURGICAL CLAIM OF THE WALK [claim G72-21]. The sons answer their father's question of dissent with HEAR, ISRAEL - his own name - THE LORD IS OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE; and he replies with his lips BLESSED BE THE NAME OF HIS GLORIOUS KINGDOM FOREVER. Which is why, the passage says, it is recited morning and evening, addressed to the patriarch in the cave: the matter you commanded us,…

THE TITLE [G72-08]. reuven BEKHORI ata — 'Reuben, MY FIRSTBORN are you': the my-firstborn word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — here, where the title is about to be stripped, and at the bush- charge where it belongs to the NATION ('my son, my firstborn, ISRAEL', Exod 4:22, armed) [VERIFIED: manifest G72-08]; the Masorah's own pair is by STRESS: two fore-stressed my-firstborns — Reuben's and EPH…

THE DEMOTION. PACHAZ ka-mayim AL TOTAR — 'unstable as water, you shall NOT EXCEL': the excess-words of 49:3 (yeter, yeter) answered by the not-excel verb of the same root: the letter takes back its own noun; alita mishkeve avikha — the Bilhah file (35:22, gen_58's span) surfaces as the legal ground; YETZUI ALA — the address breaks to third person mid-verse ('HE went up') — the readings hear the fa…

THE PAIR. shimon ve-LEVI achim — the only shared address in the testament: the Shechem partners (34:25, gen_57's span) summoned as one; kele CHAMAS — 'instruments of VIOLENCE': the flood's own indictment-word (6:11) on two sons' trade; mekherotehem — the trade- word's rare skeleton (the readings' Greek-sword reading named): the machine files the pair-address before the pair is divided (49:7).

THE REFUSED UNION [G72-09; G72-10]. al TECHAD kevodi — 'let my honor not UNITE': the unite-word's ONE Torah token [VERIFIED: manifest G72-09] — and its Scripture-partner is the tyrant DENIED the union: 'you shall not unite with them in burial' (Isa 14:20, named); the Kitzur reads the assembly as Korach's (the name withheld from the plotters' roll, restored on the singers', named); iqru-SHOR — 'the…

THE CHAIN KEEPS THE RECORD OF A RIVAL TRANSLATION'S DELIBERATE CHANGE [claim G72-25, machine-checked]. Our ink reads that in their anger they killed A MAN and in their will hamstrung AN OX - both verified here. The chain re-reads the ox as the WALL of the proselytes, making the massacre a damage to an institution. AND IT NAMES THIS AS ONE OF THE PLACES THE ELDERS ALTERED FOR KING PTOLEMY, so the k…

THE DIVISION. ARUR apam — 'cursed be their ANGER': the curse lands on the trait, not the men (the readings' mercy-note); and MS files the verse among the FIVE UNDECIDABLE of the Torah (the verses whose syntax even the marks cannot settle — his cross-refs to the altar- offerings, the almond-cups, the rising people, named): the corpus carries the undecidable class named; ACHALQEM be-yaaqov va-AFITZE…

THE PRAISE [G72-13]. yehuda ATA yodukha achekha — 'Judah — YOU, your brothers shall PRAISE you': the name conjugated into its own verb (29:35's naming closes its loop); the scribes fix this verse a COLUMN-HEAD of the Torah scroll — the yod of the six fixed head- letters (named [G72-13]: scroll layout, not stream); yadkha be-OREF oyvekha — the neck-word (the corpus's four-neck file closed at gen_69…

THE KINGSHIP EARNED BY TWO INTERVENTIONS, AND THE TRANSLATION SAYS SO. Onkelos renders the praise-clause as YOU CONFESSED AND WERE NOT ASHAMED - the name-pun read straight to the Tamar admission - and the prey-clause as FROM THE JUDGMENT OF DEATH you removed yourself. The chain counts the same two rescues: the prey of Joseph and the prey of Tamar, the two capital cases this man stopped. Chain and …

THE RISING [G72-03]. mi-TEREF BENI alita — 'from the prey, MY SON, you went up': MS settles the old argument (the Sanhedrin page; Tosafot's Tamar-reading — Judah lifted HIMSELF from the death- verdict by confessing; Rashi and Ibn Ezra) BY THE MARKS: the divider (tifcha) on the prey-word cuts it from beni — 'my son' binds to the RISING, not the prey [VERIFIED: manifest G72-03, the divider checked i…

THE SCEPTER CLAUSE [G72-01 MARQUEE; G72-12]. lo YASUR shevet mi- YHUDA — 'the scepter shall not DEPART from Judah'; ad ki yavo SHILO — 'until SHILOH comes': the testament's most argued word carried WHOLE — WRITTEN שילה with the yod and the final he exactly as the Ramah rules, as the Masorah counts, as the Zohar reads (yod-he); READ with the vav — both forms unique in the Torah, both checked in- st…

THE CRUX NAMED BY BOTH MEMBERS, AND AN ARTEFACT CITED AS EVIDENCE [claim G72-26; and G72-30]. Onkelos writes 'until THE MESSIAH COMES, FOR HIS IS THE KINGSHIP,' and the lawgiver becomes a SCRIBE from his children's children. The chain reads the same clause institutionally - the scepter as the Sanhedrin, the lawgiver as the two scribes flanking the judges - and supports it with a GENEALOGICAL SCROL…

THE VINE [G72-04; G72-12]. osri la-gefen IRO — 'binding his FOAL to the vine': the foal-word WRITTEN with the final he and READ with the vav — and its garment-twin SUTO the same, TWO written/read pairs in one verse (both pairs checked as their two tokens; the verse counts fourteen) [VERIFIED: manifest G72-04]; the Ramah marks the foal-word the Torah's EXCEPTION (every classmate full with final vav…

THE DARK EYES [G72-12]. CHAKHLILI enayim — 'eyes DARKENED [with wine]': the rare doubled-skeleton word — and MS REJECTS the large- chet claim outright: absent from every manuscript book and early print, absent from the printed Masorah's own large-letter list (he found it in one variant copy alone): a crown REJECTED is carried as a rejection — the corpus files what the chain declined as faithfully …

THE SHORE [G72-05]. le-CHOF yamim yishkon — the shore-word doubled (seas, ships): the landless-sea tribe's economy (the readings: Zebulun's trade feeding Issachar's study, named); ve-yarkhato AL tzidon — 'his flank UPON Sidon': one of the Masorah's NINE presumed- until stations — the ear expects AD ('unto'), the letter writes AL ('upon') and the Masorah locks it [VERIFIED: manifest G72-05]: the pr…

TWO INSTITUTIONS READ OUT OF ONE BLESSING AND ITS POSITION [claims G72-33 and G72-28]. The clause 'his flank shall be upon Sidon' is heard as the THIGH from which a prophet came, settling his father to this tribe and his mother to another and reconciling two masters' proofs. And the blessing's ORDER carries a patronage rule: the younger brother is blessed first because he traded and FED the one wh…

THE BEARER. yisashkhar CHAMOR garem — 'a strong-BONED donkey': the burden-image the Kitzur reads through the Masorah's pair on 'between the sheepfolds' (here and Deborah's taunt, Judg 5:16, named): the donkey that carries Israel's loads is the tribe that carries the Torah's (the Sanhedrin's majority from Issachar, the teaching- chamber half-holy half-common, named); the mother's hire-night (30:16,…

THE YOKE [G72-10]. va-yar MENUCHA ki tov — 'he saw a RESTING-PLACE, that it was good' (the tov-verdict of the creation grammar on a field); va-yet SHIKHMO lisbol — 'he BENT his shoulder to BEAR': the shoulder-word (the shekhem homograph's third face — town, portion, now the bare shoulder itself); va-yehi le-mas-OVED — 'and became a toiling SERF': joined by the maqqef per MS's ruling, and the strea…

THE JUDGE. DAN YADIN amo — the name conjugated into its verb (as Judah into praise, 49:8): the maid's firstborn judges 'as ONE of the tribes' — the readings: as the ONE tribe's own judge (as David; the Kitzur's acrostic count — the verse-heads summing to 'like David', named): full standing granted to the secondary line: the machine notes the testament's equity engine.

THE SERPENT [G72-12]. nachash ale-DEREKH... shefifon ale-ORACH — the way-words doubled for the ambusher; ha-noshekh IQVE sus — 'that bites the horse's HEELS': the heel-word with the qof dageshed FOR SPLENDOR (the second of the chapter's two beauty-dageshes, 49:10's obedience-word its twin) [VERIFIED under G72-12]; ve-yipol rokhvo ACHOR — 'its rider falls BACKWARD': the readings' Samson file opens …

THE POOLING RULE, AND ITS PROOF IS IN OUR OWN CORPUS [claim G72-22, machine-checked]. Having likened Judah to a lion, this son to a serpent, Naphtali to a doe and Benjamin to a wolf, the father then INCLUDED THEM ALL IN ONE ANOTHER'S BLESSINGS - made them all lions and all serpents. The proof offered is checkable and holds: this tribe is a SERPENT here and a LION'S CUB in Moses' blessing, both in …

THE CRY [G72-02]. li-yshuatkha QIVITI YHWH — 'for Your salvation I WAIT, O LORD': three words, no mid-verse pause, the testament's shortest breath — and the stream's own census makes it the LAST four-letter Name in the book of Genesis: no Name-token after it, and only this one since the Potiphar span — the Name that saturated the beginnings withdraws through the whole Joseph cycle and exits the bo…

THE INTERRUPTION IS EXPLAINED TWICE, AND NEITHER READING IS RANKED [claim G72-32]. One has the patriarch seeing Samson, taking him for the deliverer, then seeing that he would die - 'will this one also die?' The other redirects the hope entirely: THIS one will not bring salvation, it will come from Gad, because the raiding clause is heard to the one who comes AT THE END, the prophet held to be of …

THE RAID. GAD GEDUD yegudenu ve-hu YAGUD aqev — the name run through four of its own conjugations in six words: raided and raiding back 'at the HEEL' (the aqev-word: the heel-file of 49:17 continued verse-to-verse); the Kitzur's Masorah-pair named ('a people shall raid him' — the troops returned on their heel, the borderland tribe raiding the raiders home): the machine notes the letter's economy —…

THE RICH BREAD. me-ASHER shemena LACHMO — 'from Asher, his bread is RICH': the happiness-name (30:13) yields the fat land (the readings: the oil-valleys of the north, named); maadane-MELEKH — 'KING'S delicacies': the bread-ledger of the span (the famine's bread, the fifth's bread) closes on delicacy: the machine notes the testament promising what the machine spent ten chapters rationing.

THE HIND [G72-06; G72-07]. ayala SHELUCHA — 'a hind SENT FORTH': LEAN in the Hilleli and all the books, and the Ramah's mnemonic seals the pair — 'Naphtali's LEAN, Esau's FULL': the full form stands ONCE in the whole Torah, at Esau's PRESENT (32:19) — the gift-word fattened for the appeaser, thinned for the runner [VERIFIED: manifest G72-06]; ha-NOTEN imre SHAFER — 'who GIVES fair sayings': the pr…

THE FRUITFUL SON [G72-12; G72-13]. BEN PORAT yosef ben PORAT ale- AYIN — the fruit-word doubled by the spring (the parah-root the covenant promised, 48:4, and 47:27 narrated); PORAT with the resh in QAMATS both times (most books, old prints, Or Torah — asserted under G72-12); the Kitzur: the only son addressed WITHOUT his name first — honor to the crown — and ben porat = MANASSEH-AND-EPHRAIM by co…

THE ARCHERS [G72-12]. va-yemararuHU va-ROBU va-yistemuHU — embittered, shot, hated: the brothers' history compressed to three verbs (the hate-verb of 37:4 — the healed speech's original wound — in its last conjugation); VA-YEMARARUHU written LEAN with the midrash's own lean-reading named ('he embittered' — the wound read both directions, the Yefe Toar named, never merged) [VERIFIED under G72-12]; …

THE THREAD THE CYCLE OPENED WITH CLOSES HERE [claim G72-31]. Three embitterings counted and weighed by the choice of verb. Then the teaching: slanderers are likened to ARROWS because every other weapon strikes near and this strikes far - speech in one country kills in another. And the broom-bush coals, which alone among coals burn on inside though quenched without: one who receives evil speech, ev…

THE STAY. va-TESHEV be-ETAN qashto — 'his bow STAYED in strength' (the Kitzur: he strengthened against them — the bow that did not shoot back); mi-yde AVIR yaaqov — 'from the hands of the MIGHTY ONE of Jacob'; mi-sham ROE EVEN yisrael — 'from there, the SHEPHERD, the STONE of Israel': the shepherd-name for God again (48:15's file), now beside the Stone (the entity registry's divine-name cluster: l…

BOW, PASSION, OR PROPHECY - A GENUINE THREE-WAY ON ONE WORD [claim G72-30 context]. Onkelos writes HIS PROPHECY WAS FULFILLED IN THEM, BECAUSE HE KEPT THE TORAH IN SECRET; the chain reads the same noun as his PASSION drawn and slackened, with the father's image cooling his blood. And the support formula takes its third seat this sweep - the WORD of the God of your father will be YOUR SUPPORT. [fol…

THE STACK. birkhot SHAMAYIM me-AL, birkhot TEHOM rovetzet TACHAT — 'blessings of HEAVEN above, blessings of the DEEP crouching below': the creation's two registers (1:7's split waters) recruited as blessing-strata; the Kitzur's Masorah-threes named — me-AL (heaven- above: here, the dew of 27:39, the court of Deut 4:36... his three) and ROVETZET (the crouching deep, the crouching mother-bird of the…

THE CROWN [G72-10; G72-12]. birkhot AVIKHA gavru al birkhot HORAI — 'YOUR father's blessings PREVAILED above my parents'': Jacob measures his own testament against the ones he received (27:28's dew, 28:13's land) and rules his GREATER; ad-TAAVAT givot OLAM — 'unto the DESIRE of the everlasting hills': joined by the maqqef per MS's ruling, the third of the file, and the stream writes all three hyph…

THE WOLF [G72-11; G72-13]. BINYAMIN zeev YITRAF — 'Benjamin is a wolf that TEARS': the teref-root's last testament token (Judah rose from it, 49:9; Benjamin hunts by it); written FULL in the Hilleli and all books — one of the Masorah's SEVENTEEN full in Scripture — and the stream's Torah-census closes the corpus's running file: SEVEN full Benjamins, from the naming (35:18) through the mouth- witne…

THE SALE'S FURTHEST CONSEQUENCE: A LOCATION [claim G72-23]. The tribes contend over where the Temple will stand and are told - you are all righteous, but you are all THIEVES; every one of you took part in the sale. But Benjamin, who did not, is 'the mountain God desired.' The site's title awarded by absence from a crime eleven chapters back. Onkelos states the same conclusion outright, writing tha…

THE TWELVE SEALED [G72-13]. kol ele shivte yisrael SHENEM ASAR — 'all these are the tribes of Israel, TWELVE': the narrator counts what the ledger of gen_69 listed — the machine installs the mandate on the twelve as one body; ISH asher ke-VIRKHATO berakh otam — 'EACH MAN according to HIS blessing': the letter insists the twelve addresses were all BLESSINGS (the rebukes included — the readings on R…

A FACT ABOUT THE READING SHELF, NOT ABOUT A VERSE [claim G72-30]. Through forty-eight chapters the declared translation renders, deviating only at points this corpus has logged one by one. In THIS chapter it becomes an INTERPRETIVE PARAPHRASE - seven consecutive middle blessings given as their fulfilments, conquests and territories and a chosen man whose terror falls on the Philistines. The larges…

THE CHARGE [G72-12]. ani NEESAF el ami — 'I am being GATHERED to my people' (the samekh in qamats per the Masorah, the Isaiah station named — asserted under G72-12): the gather-verb before the death — the man narrates his own transition; QIVRU oti el AVOTAI — 'BURY me with my FATHERS': the burial charge now pushed on ALL the sons (47:29-30 bound Joseph alone by oath; the testament binds the twelve…

THE DEED. asher QANA avraham — 'which Abraham BOUGHT': the dying man recites the purchase (23:16-18, gen_38's span) with its parties and its consideration — the machine notes the third ACHUZA of the arc: Pharaoh's grant (47:11), the covenant's everlasting one (48:4), and the ACHUZAT QAVER — the burial-holding: the only land the family owns by deed is a grave, and the testament stakes everything on…

THE THERE-LEDGER. SHAMA... SHAMA... ve-SHAMA — the there-word three times over three couples: the cave's register recited (Abraham- Sarah, Isaac-Rebekah — and then the first person breaks in); QAVARTI et LEA — 'I buried LEAH': the only burial in the list told in the first person — the unloved wife (29:31's ledger) disclosed as the one beside whom he will lie: the machine sets this beside 48:7 (Rac…

THE CLOSING LINE. miqne ha-SADE — 'the PURCHASE of the field': the deed's own noun (the miqne-skeleton that meant livestock through the famine-chapters means acquisition here — the homograph's quiet turn); me-et bene-CHET — from the sons of Heth: the verse has no mid-verse pause (the deed's unbroken breath — split at its strongest stroke per the fallback law): the testament's last words before the…

THE GATHERING. va-yekhal yaaqov LE-TZAVOT — 'Jacob FINISHED charging' (the charge-verb to its end: the testament complete to the last clause); va-yeESOF raglav el ha-MITA — 'he GATHERED his feet INTO the bed': the span's bed-triple closes (the head 47:31, the upon 48:2, the into here); va-YIGVA va-yeASEF el amav — 'he EXPIRED, and was GATHERED to his people': the gather-verb three times across the…

Three commands are itemized - against idolatry, against blaspheming the Name, and the bearing of the bier: let no uncircumcised man touch it, THREE FROM THE NORTH, THREE FROM THE SOUTH, THREE FROM THE EAST, THREE FROM THE WEST - 'and just as you do for me, so you will be arrayed in four banners in the wilderness, wit…
